title: Jesse Felder: Did The Bust Just Begin?

excerpts.label: Delays → first cancellations: the writing on the wall
excerpts.insight: Data centers delayed all year; now the FIRST cancellations are appearing — the trigger that turns the AI boom into a bust as analysts reprice.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: TRAIL-STOP the AI complex. The catalyst Felder watches (cancellations, not delays) has arrived. Tighten stops on semis/hyperscalers; don't chase +95% YTD SOXX into a repricing.

excerpts.label: The earnings illusion: revenue now, depreciation later
excerpts.insight: ~$750B 2026 AI capex; NVDA/memory book revenue immediately while hyperscalers defer the depreciation — a timing mismatch inflating reported earnings that reverses as charges land.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE the 'earnings are awesome' narrative on hyperscalers. The reported-earnings boom is a depreciation-timing artifact; margin compression is the second-wave catalyst. Underweight MSFT/META (both below 200dma).

excerpts.label: The physics constraint: two-thirds haven't broken ground
excerpts.insight: ~2/3 of data centers due in 2027 haven't broken ground; Nadella's 'warm shells' bottleneck is worse 6 months on — nowhere to plug the chips, so semi revenue estimates must fall.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SHORT/AVOID the picks-and-shovels at peak multiples. SOXX trades 95% YTD on revenue the physical buildout can't absorb. The estimate cut is mechanical, not optional.

excerpts.label: Maleficent Seven: monopolies now competing, FCF gone
excerpts.insight: Grantham frame — former monopolies (Google/Meta/Microsoft) now fight in one capital-intensive arena; combined free cash flow is zero/negative, forcing bond issuance to fund capex.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Re-rate the Mag-7 as the 'Maleficent Seven.' When FCF goes negative and bonds fund capex, the quality premium compresses. Watch credit spreads on hyperscaler debt as the tell.

excerpts.label: Oil to $150: greatest disruption in history, suppressed
excerpts.insight: Fundamentals say crude ~$150; price held down by China importing ~5 mbd less + record SPR draws. Strait of Hormuz: 6–8 months to 80% flow even if reopened today.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG energy — oil already +59% YTD (our bars) yet XLE is only 3% of the S&P (vs 8–12% historically) and -9% off its high. The +50% crude move is NOT in the shares. Best AI-bust hedge.

excerpts.label: Gold leads commodities/rates by 20 months → 6% 10Y
excerpts.insight: Gold's 2-year rally is a ~20-month leading indicator for commodities, oil, and rates; Felder reads it as oil → $150 and the 10-year yield → 6% within 6–12 months.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STEEPENER / short duration. If gold's signal holds, the 10Y at 6% guts the long bond and forces a Fed hike INTO an AI bust — the stagflation pincer. Own TIPS over nominals.

excerpts.label: The Fed pincer: 4% CPI forces a hike into the bust
excerpts.insight: With CPI ~4% and core PCE hotter, rising commodities force the Fed to hike just as the AI wealth-effect economy slows — the punch-bowl removal that historically ends bubbles.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: DEFENSIVE + real assets. Hike-into-slowdown is the worst tape for long-duration tech. Rotate to energy, healthcare, staples (insider buying), cash/T-bills; lean away from precious metals until the Fed pivots.
